sourceShaPolicy: Resolved from GitHub Actions SOURCE_SHA after the single final commit; never hard-coded before commit creation.

p0.statement: No direct P0 code blocker remains for FE auth/session after fail-closed state-machine hardening.

controls: revoke stale profile and permissions when JWT changes
auth/me cache removed on context switch
logout clears token, context, permission and query cache
multi-context login commits auth state only after switch-context
active context is never inferred from the first available context

viteVitestDisposition.rule: Separate ESM-safe Vite and Vitest configs; verifier rejects legacy loader coupling.

qa1.required: DEV/UAT 401, 403, token expiry, refresh, permission, data-scope, audit, no-stack-trace, 409, 422 and idempotency evidence on exact build/SHA.

qa2.required: Login redirect, session refresh, logout, /errors/403, role navigation, Chrome/Edge and desktop/tablet/mobile evidence on exact build/SHA.

backend.required: Direct API deny 403, data-scope deny, audit correctness, OpenAPI/Postman version/hash, permission catalog and sample 403/409/422/idempotency.

bas.required: Versioned field/state matrix with approver and traceability.

ba.required: Approved business rule, label, validation and error-state mapping.

finalGateRule: WWHN-35 may be Done only when FE1, BE1, QA1, QA2, BAS and BA evidence all pass against the same approved environment/build/source SHA.
